# Mission Description Document (MDD) - Template
*Based on ECSS-E-ST-10C Annex B (DRD: Mission description document)*

---

## 1. Introduction
*The MDD shall contain a description of the purpose, objective, content and the reason prompting its preparation (e.g. logic, organization, process or procedure).*

- **1.1 Purpose and Objectives**: [Describe the purpose and objectives of this specific mission concept]
- **1.2 Scope**: [Define the scope of the mission concept described in this document]
- **1.3 Definitions, Acronyms and Abbreviations**: [List project-specific terms or reference standard glossaries]

---

## 2. Applicable and Reference Documents
*The MDD shall list the applicable and reference documents in support to the generation of the document, and include, as a minimum, the current preliminary technical requirements specification.*

### 2.1 Applicable Documents
| Doc ID | Title | Issue/Rev |
|--------|-------|-----------|
| [AD-1] | Preliminary Technical Requirements Specification (TS / URD / SRD) | [X.Y] |
| [AD-2] | ECSS-E-ST-10C - System Engineering General Requirements | Rev. 1 |

### 2.2 Reference Documents
| Doc ID | Title | Issue/Rev |
|--------|-------|-----------|
| [RD-1] | [Reference Document Title] | [X.Y] |

---

## 3. Preliminary Technical Requirements Specification Summary
*The MDD shall provide a summary of the preliminary technical requirements specification objectives and list the design driving requirements, derived from the current initial specification.*

- **3.1 Summary of Objectives**: [High-level summary of objectives from the technical specification]
- **3.2 Design Driving Requirements**: [List key requirements driving the architecture and design]

---

## 4. Concept Description
*The MDD shall provide a complete description of the mission concept, covering elements, phases, constraints, and scenarios.*

### 4.1 Overview of the Concept
- [General description of the mission architecture and philosophy]

### 4.2 Mission Analysis
- **4.2.1 Orbit and Trajectory**: [Orbital parameters, coverage, lifetime, delta-V budgets]
- **4.2.2 Environment**: [Space environment, radiation, thermal, orbital perturbations]

### 4.3 System Description (Element by Element)
- **4.3.1 Space Segment**:
  - Payload
  - Platform (Power, AOCS, Propulsion, C&DH, Structures, Thermal)
- **4.3.2 Ground Segment**:
  - Functional Requirements and Major Elements
  - Monitoring and Control Segment
  - Data Processing Segment
- **4.3.3 User Segment**:
  - Functional Requirements and Major Elements
  - Monitoring requirements

### 4.4 Description of How the System Works in Each Mission Phase
- **4.4.1 Launch Preparation & Lift-off**
- **4.4.2 Launch and Early Orbit Phase (LEOP)**
- **4.4.3 In-Orbit Commissioning**
- **4.4.4 Nominal Operations**
- **4.4.5 Spacecraft Disposal (End of Life / De-orbiting)**

### 4.5 Performance Drivers
- [Key performance parameters and constraints driving sizing]

### 4.6 Constraints
- [Mass, volume, power, cost, schedule, regulatory or launcher constraints]

### 4.7 Main Events
- [Critical timeline events, maneuvers, or deployments]

### 4.8 Operations Scenarios
- [Reference operational scenarios and observation characteristics]
- [Operability and autonomy requirements]

---

## 5. Assessment of the Performance
*The MDD shall provide the assessment against the current preliminary technical requirements specification requirements, and identification of non-compliances, and their impact.*

- **5.1 Compliance Matrix / Assessment**: [Evaluation of how well this concept meets the TS]
- **5.2 Non-Compliances and Impacts**: [List any deviations or inability to meet specific requirements and their consequences]

---

## 6. Identification of Risk Areas
*The MDD shall provide the list of identified risk related to the concept, including as a minimum technology, contingencies handling, and programmatic aspects.*

- **6.1 Technological Risks**: [Critical technologies, TRL levels, single-point failures]
- **6.2 Contingencies and Failure Handling**: [Robustness, contingency modes]
- **6.3 Programmatic Risks**: [Schedule, cost, critical path items]
- **6.4 Trade-off Analysis**: [Comparison against alternative concepts and justification of selection]

---

## 7. Conclusion
*The MDD shall summarize the strengths and weaknesses of the concept.*

- **7.1 Strengths**: [Key advantages of this mission concept]
- **7.2 Weaknesses**: [Key disadvantages or vulnerabilities]

---

## 8. Special Remarks
*None (or specific project notes).*
